name: unityai
description: Standalone local AI development orchestrator for Unity projects

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @unityai/shared && npm run build --workspace @unityai/core && npm run build --workspace @unityai/server && npm run build --workspace @unityai/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @unityai/web
